purpose: Teach: 真夜中/どっと/あげく/大金/居間/つぶやい/しつこい/うろうろ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、真夜中はお家にいなきゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you can't be out of the house at midnight.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. A low, steady voice—the tone of someone setting a boundary she cares about. Not scolding, but clear. A pause before his name, like she's gathering him in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、運動会で観客がどっと来たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, the crowd just flooded in at the sports day!
lines.style: Bright, bubbling excitement. Quick intake of breath before the rush of words. Animated, almost bouncing in the voice. The thrill of a memory he wants to share right now.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お友達と遊んだあげく、ケンカしちゃダメよ
lines.en: Sho, you can't play with your friends and then get into a fight with them.
lines.style: Patient, gentle correction. Warm but deliberate. The cadence of someone who's said something like this before and will say it again. A slight lean-in, like she's making sure he hears the care underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お祖父ちゃんが、ぼくに大金くれたって、嘘よ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Grandpa didn't really give me all that money.
lines.style: Small, knowing smile in the voice. Dry and self-aware—a child who's caught himself in a half-truth and is letting her in on the joke. Quiet, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの居間で一緒に絵本読もうね
lines.en: Sho, let's read a picture book together in my living room, okay?
lines.style: Soft and inviting. A small smile warming the opening. Slow, unhurried pace. The voice of someone creating a safe, quiet moment. Gentle downslope at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ありがとうって、お祖母ちゃんにつぶやいたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I told Grandma thank you. I whispered it to her.
lines.style: Proud but quiet. A child's careful disclosure—something he did right and wants witnessed. Warm undercurrent. Slight breathiness, like he's been holding this in waiting for her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、しつこい質問をしないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't ask me those repetitive questions, okay?
lines.style: Affectionate boundary-setting. A touch of weariness, but not unkind. Light, almost playful firmness. The tone of someone who knows him well enough to tease while she's saying no.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、公園でうろうろしてたら、お父さんに見つかった
lines.en: Mei-sis, I was wandering around the park and Dad found me.
lines.style: Dry, a little sheepish. Understated delivery—he's telling her something mildly embarrassing but with a wry acceptance. Quiet confidence underneath. A knowing look without the words.
